summary: Short kerb at a bridge-approach junction, with four No Stopping signs.
reasons: Four No Stopping Any Time signs
Junction and bridge approach, no room off lane

drivers.seclusion: Nearest house is 21 m west; rail corridor to the east, but the kerb is exposed at a busy junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow kerb strip beside a median and turning lanes; no verge or pull-off for a van.
drivers.traffic: Through route onto the bridge with turn lanes and arrows, plus rail noise.
drivers.convention: No parked cars on this kerb; signs prohibit stopping.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs at the kerb
sun_shade: Open to the sky with a little shade from trees on the west side in the afternoon.
